title: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) Service Extension for Delivery Status Notifications (DSNs)
summary: Defines an extension to SMTP that lets a client request Delivery Status Notifications. The client can say when notifications should be generated, whether the original content should be returned, and attach extra information so the sender can identify which recipient and transaction a notice refers to.

eli5.summary: When you send a letter you can ask for a receipt. This lets email senders ask the mail system to send back a report on whether delivery worked.

questions: how to request a dsn in smtp
